tei:div.tei:p: 343) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: dbang chen pad+ma he ru ka'i cha lag drag po'i las kyi sbyor ba bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

pad+ma he ru ka la bdud: drag po'i las kyi cha rkyen du: dkar gsum gtor ma skyems bcas bshams: ting nge 'dzin gyi nus byin brlab: 'bru gsum yi ges bdud rtsir bsgyur: de nas gser skyems 'bul ba ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: skyabs gnas rin chen dkon mchog rnam gsum dang: brgyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i tshogs: gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: rgyud sde rgya mtsho theg dgur 'brel ba yi: bka' dgongs phur gsum yi dam lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: gnas yul zhing skyong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang: dam can gter bdag bstan srung rgya mtsho la: gser skyems= phyogs 'dir rgyu ba'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha: pho lha dgra bla 'go ba'i lha lnga sogs: drag shul myur mgyogs ldan pa'i srung ma la: gser skyems= dam nyams dgra bgegs 'gugs bsgral dus la babs: thugs dam ma g.yel mngon spyod las mdzod cig: 344) de nas gzu dpang ni: kyai: ye shes spyan ldan mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma gzu dang dpang: yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs= sku gsum ye shes mkha' 'gro= bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho= khyed rnams gzu dpang mkhyen brtse'i spyan ma brtul: nga ni ma lan byang chub bsgrub pa la: dam nyams dgra bos sgrub tu ma ster ro: bsam gtan sems dkrugs sgrub po'i tshogs kyang bcag: dgon sde bcom zhing bstan pa rmang nas bshig: mtha' mi ha rar bsdebs nas nang 'khrugs byed: nyes med sems can yongs la gnod pa brtsams: dkar phyogs sdang zhing nag phyogs grogs su bsten: bka' las 'gal zhing dam las log pa yi: zhing bcu'i ru tra dam nyams sdig can 'di: mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis ma 'dul na: rgyal bstan bshig cing bshad sgrub bstan pa nyams: sems can yongs la gnod cing ngan 'gror 'phen: kho yang las kyi rnam smin gting re zab:

thar med duḥkha'i gnas su ltung nye bas: khyed rnams thugs dam ma g.yel gzu dang dpang: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams: mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis 345) tshar chod la: 'gugs bsgral sgrol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab bo sa ma ya: de nas phur bu byin gyis brlab pa ni: bdag nyid dbang chen yab yum du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang g.yon pa nyi ma'i gdan la rigs lnga yab yum gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi sprin chen sras kyi rnam par ye shes kyi khro bo kī la ya gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan cing gzi brjid 'od phung rab tu 'bar ba: sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur bu rno dbal dang ldan cing gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad 'gugs bsgral brlag par byed pa'i mthu nus dang ldan par bskyed do: de'i gnas gsum las 'od 'phros pas sku gsum dbyings bzhugs kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mthu dang nus pa byin rlabs ye shes kyi dbang byin thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par byung nas phur bu la thim pas dbang byin nus pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya phur pa ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñca s+t+wam̐: de nas tshe lung ni: ngo bo sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa 346)la rang bzhin rdo rje gsum gyi rnam par shar ba'i phur pa de nyid dgra bgegs kyi snying gar 'dril ba tsam gyis 'o ma las mar thon pa ltar kho'i tshe bsod mthu nus thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo yi ge nṛ ljang gu'i rnam par phur bu'i khong seng nas brgyud de 'od kyi rnam par rang gi snying gar thim pas tshe bsod dpal yon mthu nus thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam: yang phur pa de nyid dgra bgegs kyi snying gar tshad pa tsam gyis kho'i bla'i ngo bo yi ge nṛḥyig 'od dang bcas pa chu thig hub kyis btungs pa ltar phur bu'i rtse mor 'ub kyis 'dus te phur pa la thim par phur pa de nyid mthu stobs nus byin gzi 'od bkrag mdangs dang ldan cing rgyal ba rnams kyi phrin las yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthu byin dang ldan par bsam:

de nas khrus lung ni: slar yang phur pa'i rtse mo nas byin rlabs ye shes kyi 'od phung dkar gsal zla ba'i mdangs ltar thib kyis byung nas dgra bgegs la phog pas kho'i rgyud kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa ltar sangs kyis dag nas me long g.ya' bral bzhin du gyur par bsam: oṃ sarba pa paṃ da ha na shud+dhe bi shud+dhi sarba a pa na ye swā hā: 347) de nas gnas lung ni: yang phur pa de nyid dgra bgaigs kyi snying la gzir bas rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar po a yig gis mtshan pa can du gyur nas phur pa'irtse mor 'ub kyis 'dus te khong seng nas yar drangs te dug gsum nyon 'khrul gyi sgrib pa ma lus pa sbyangs: sku gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi don rgyud la skyes nas mdun bskyed lha'i thugs kar thim pas 'khrul med ka dag gi dbyings su sangs rgyas par gyur: āḥ phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ phaṭaḥ ces brjod mi dmigs khyab brdal ngang: sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor zhig pa bzhin: ka dag dbyings su 'byams blas bya: de nas gzugs phung 'khor ba'i rgyu: rgyal ba'i phrin las zor gyis brlag: de ltar gnad dang ldan gyur na: don gnyis grub nas tshe 'di ru: he ru ka pa mngon gyur nges: the tshom med do sa ma ya: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams la 'di ma 'phrad: dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di'ang rang gi nye gnas yi ge'i rig byed shākya'i dge btsun dam pa tshul khrims rdo rjes nan cher bskul ngor su kha badz+ra gyis nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// maṅga lam// 348)
